data.name: Gaseous Form
data.description: As a standard action, you can assume gaseous form (as the spell). You can remain gaseous for %1 minute. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments. You can bring other creatures with you in gaseous form, but each passenger costs an additional minute per minute of travel.|OracleGaseousFormDuration
